Vacancy description

Sales Manager M/F

Are you a commercially driven sales professional with a passion for industrial technology and new business development?

At KK Group, we are looking for an ambitious and results-oriented Sales Manager – Safety Monitoring (Industry) to drive our expansion into new industrial markets and unlock significant growth opportunities.

With decades of experience in condition and safety monitoring solutions for rotating machinery, KK Group has built a strong technological foundation in mission-critical applications. We are now looking to strengthen our position within the industrial sector, with a particular focus on Italy and other selected markets.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on identifying new business opportunities, building long-term customer relationships and turning market potential into commercial success.

You will play a key role in shaping our market presence, developing new customer partnerships and positioning our safety monitoring solutions across a broad range of industrial applications.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 27/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Copenhagen

Responsibilities

As our new Sales Manager, you will take ownership of driving new business development and expanding our customer base within the industrial sector. Working closely with our technical experts and product specialists, you will combine commercial insight with a strong understanding of industrial applications to identify opportunities and deliver value to our customers.

• Drive new-business sales activities with a strong hunter mentality.

• Identify, qualify and engage new customers across Fans, Pumps, Air Compressors, Mixers/Crushers/Sifters, and Process Equipment.

• Build a solid pipeline by targeting OEMs, industrial end-users, and distributors in target markets.

• Position KK’s safety monitoring solutions vs. key competitors.

• Develop offers, deliver presentations, and negotiate contracts.

• Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and customer intelligence gathering.

• Collaborate with technical experts and product specialists.

• Represent KK at industry events and exhibitions.

• Report pipeline progress and market insights.

Our requirements

We imagine that you bring a strong commercial mindset, solid technical understanding and a proven ability to develop new business within industrial markets.

You are motivated by creating opportunities rather than waiting for them, and you enjoy the challenge of entering new markets, establishing customer relationships and building a business from the ground up.

• Significant (5-10 years) B2B sales experience in the industrial machinery sector.

• Proven new-business development (hunter) background.

• Experience selling technical products to OEMs, end-users, or distributors.

• Strong understanding of rotating equipment or mechanical/electromechanical systems.

• Ability to engage stakeholders from engineers to senior management.

• Self-driven, structured, persistent, motivated by building new markets.

• Fluent in English, and ideally also Italian.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If you are a commercially driven sales professional with a passion for industrial technology, new business development, and building strong customer relationships, we encourage you to submit your CV in English and apply today.

Join us in expanding KK Group's presence in industrial safety monitoring and driving growth in new markets. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

M&A Senior Manager, Corporate Development

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and play a key role in shaping the growth of an international company with ambitious plans?

We are looking for an M&A Senior Manager, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and help drive our M&A strategy and broaden strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work hands-on across the full deal lifecycle, from identifying and evaluating acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will take ownership of key transaction workstreams, work closely with senior stakeholders across the organization, and bring together financial analysis, commercial thinking and strategic insight to support important investment decisions.

The role offers significant responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close collaboration with senior management, within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Madrid office three days per week.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 27/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Copenhagen

Responsibilities

• Perform and review financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Take responsibility for key workstreams in M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Identify, screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Develop investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities, and contribute to the preparation of investment recommendations.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify and assess potential acquisition targets, new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support transaction structuring, negotiations and other activities throughout the transaction process.

• Work with business divisions and integration teams to identify and assess potential synergies and support post-acquisition integration planning.

• Contribute to broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Our requirements

We expect you to have 4-6 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial and transaction-related capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including extensive experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Solid experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities, including responsibility for managing individual workstreams.

• Strong commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations and investment judgement.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured investment cases and decision material.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions to senior stakeholders.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and drive your own workstreams forward.

Ready to take ownership of key M&A workstreams and help shape KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Do you have a passion for building strategic customer relationships and turning complex opportunities into long-term business success? Are you motivated by helping accelerate the energy transition through offshore wind solutions? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

• Driving strategic sales opportunities from qualification through contract award and handover.
• Developing and executing winning strategies for key tenders and commercial opportunities.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic customers and supporting key account development.
• Leading customer negotiations in collaboration with technical, operational, legal, procurement, and finance stakeholders.
• Identifying and pursuing business growth opportunities, including cross-selling, upselling, and framework agreements.
• Ensuring high-quality commercial proposals, risk assessments, and governance approvals.
• Promoting a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity in all commercial activities.

Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a customer-focused environment and has a proven track record of managing complex sales opportunities - preferably from the wind industry. 

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you: 

• Have significant experience with complex B2B sales, opportunity and tender management, contract negotiations, and the development of winning strategies for strategic sales opportunities.
• Bring experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, technical service, or related industries.
• Have a strong understanding of customer decision processes, competitive positioning, value creation, and commercial risk management.
• Have experience with key account management, account planning, and building long-term customer relationships.
• Are comfortable coordinating cross-functional sales and bid activities involving multiple stakeholders.
• Possess strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills and work in a structured, proactive, and results-oriented manner.
• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing, and are willing to travel as part of the role. 

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.
Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

_Be the person the project teams call before every big decision. Let AI do the heavy lifting, so you can spend your time where it counts: challenging the numbers and shaping the outcome.

_European Energy is a growing company in the renewable energy sector. We are a privately owned Danish company founded in 2004, with our headquarters in Copenhagen. We develop, construct, and operate solar (PV), onshore wind and hybrid BESS projects globally, as well as Power-to-X projects. We are present across the full renewable energy value chain from development to operations and asset management but are also very active in M&A to recycle capital into new activities. Our core values form the foundation of everything we do: In It Together, Trust and Courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion, and Agility.**Your New Team

**FP&A owns the financial management framework within European Energy: the financial data warehouse, project controlling, budgets/forecasts including performance management, management reporting, group business plan, inputs to investment decisions and capital allocation. We are a team of 12, international and informal, and we already use AI every day. Now we are making AI the way we work, not a side tool. You report to Anders Lykke Jacobsen, VP, Head of FP&A.

**Your New Role

**You build, analyse, and solve. With modern tools and AI doing the heavy lifting, you bring the direction, judgement, and drive that turn numbers into decisions.

You are a sparring partner for the business, someone who points attention to what matters and helps get it solved.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Build modern tools: dashboards, automations, and reusable AI workflows

• Anchor it all in stable models: budgets, forecasts, cost-to-complete

• Analyse performance across projects and the portfolio, and direct management’s attention to the variances, risks, and opportunities that matter

• Analyse business decisions from a financial perspective, identify issues and develop solutions with the business, and provide clear, actionable recommendations.

• Contribute to the group budget, forecast, and management reporting cycles, and take responsibility for the quality of everything AI helps you deliver

**Prerequisites to progress in the job

**

• You think in numbers and understand value chains deeply

• You direct AI like a sharp colleague: you brief it well, ask deep questions, collaborate, test what comes back, and know when it is wrong

• You are not satisfied until the routine is automated and is a solid part of recurring deliverables

• You learn fast and share what you learn, because the tools change every month

• You have high work capacity and are driven by hard problems and by delivering results

**With us you get

**

• Real influence on how a modern FP&A team works with AI

• Close collaboration with project, construction, and finance colleagues across an international organisation

**European Energy at a glance – The Power of Tomorrow, Today

**We are now more than 930 employees with 47 nationalities represented in 21 countries, and we are growing rapidly in both Copenhagen and across our global offices. We all work for our common goal to be a leading partner in the green transition and to create _The Power of Tomorrow, Today.

_Our working environment is built on mutual respect for the varied strengths and talents of our employees, with a flat hierarchy and a culture that encourages initiative and innovation. Our employees value our flexible working culture, permitting better reconciliation of work and personal life. We are a team, whether it is in the workplace, on our company trips or during our weekly company training sessions. At European Energy, you will work with colleagues from around the world and become part of a collaborative international network.

We lead with purpose. At European Energy, our leadership culture is built on six guiding principles that shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. These principles help us act responsibly and empower each other to succeed.

**Apply Now

****Workplace: Søborg, Copenhagen

**Reference: Anders Lykke Jacobsen, VP, Head of FP&A.

How to apply: We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or background. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask that you do not include a photograph in your CV. We assess all candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the position once a suitable candidate has been identified. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email or any other direct messaging channels. Applications must be submitted through the designated application link.

Contact person: For more information about the position, please reach out to Anders Lykke, VP, Head of FP&A on alj@europeanenergy.com

**The opportunity

**Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better. Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers?

Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? Would you like to have an outsized impact in a small Copenhagen B2B SaaS company, and make your mark on the Nordics last-mile logistics market? If so, Mover might be the right place for you.

We are currently brewing up new product ideas, and in need of strong product managers. We are looking for someone willing to take ownership of specific commercial goals and realize them with a great product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineering and leadership to shape the future of our last-mile platform. If that’s something for you, then please read on!

**Role Overview And Responsibilities

****As a Product Manager you will:

**

• Turn strategy into reality: Launch a new B2B SaaS product in the first 12 months.

• Take ownership and deliver results on revenue, gross profit and related commercial goals for your product.

• Lead a small product team in a matrix-style org structure (not a people manager, but a team leader).

• Use AI to its full potential - in the product development process, and in the product itself.

• Perform market research and help drive our continuous discovery process.

• Talk to customers. A lot. Both existing and prospects.

• Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and customers.

• Take a primarily data-driven approach to product development and product operations.

• Have a real, measurable impact on the daily lives of thousands of drivers across Europe.

**Your mindset

**

• You are driven by purpose and want to contribute to our mission of changing logistics for good.

• You are driven, tenacious, and can work independently. You think big and insist on the highest standards. You have a bias for action and accomplish more with less. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have strong opinions and no issue voicing them. However, once a decision has been made, you commit wholly to the path forward.

• You can sell a vision to customers.

**What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

**

• You have successfully launched a new product.

**About you

**

• We imagine you have 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, but we are also interested in equivalent qualifications from marketing, sales or other commercial functions, with relevant project management experience and customer obsession.

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability and curiosity to quickly learn a complex domain (last-mile logistics).

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• Experience working with cross-functional product teams.

• Understanding of software life-cycle processes: How software is built, maintained and scaled.

**What we offer

**

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• A steep learning curve in a fast-moving technology company.

• Autonomy, trust, and support to do the best work of your career.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

• Aaaand, a great lunch, modern offices and a cool location at Islands Brygge in the center of Copenhagen…

**Mover’s values

**We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality.

• Lead with integrity. We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value. It means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics

• Be accountable. We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results

• Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

Department: Cloud

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the Role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews — giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

**About you

**We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**
